# Results — Study 201 (Dividend-Growth) on real annual panel

*Generated by [`examples/verify.py`](../examples/verify.py). One recipe — equal-weight
portfolio of names in a 40-stock large-cap basket with ≥ 3 consecutive years of annual
dividend raises (via `yf.Ticker.dividends`), rebalanced annually at December 31, forward
return = next-calendar-year auto-adjusted total return — pinned against the equal-weight
full basket (unconditional baseline) and a high-yield non-grower comparator. As-of
**2026-06-15**.*

## Bias warning (top of results)

**Survivorship bias is intentional and named on the Signal axis.** The 40-name universe
consists of large-cap US dividend payers alive as of 2026-06-15. Companies that cut or
eliminated dividends, were acquired, or were delisted are absent. The entire basket is
pre-selected for survival; the grower screen applies a second filter inside an already-biased
pool. Any measured return advantage for either arm vs the other arm is a *within-survivor*
comparison, not a comparison vs the full market.

## Data stamp

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Source | Yahoo Finance (`yfinance`, `yf.Ticker(t).history(period="max", auto_adjust=True)` + `.dividends`) |
| Universe | 40 large-cap US dividend payers (survivorship-biased, named above) |
| Panel years | 2000 – 2025 |
| Grower definition | ≥ 3 consecutive calendar years of dividend raises (annual sum strict increase AND both years ≥ $0.01/share) |
| Forward return | Calendar year *y+1* auto-adjusted (total-return) close-to-close return |
| Panel fingerprint | `c8e068f91cf5` |
| As-of | 2026-06-15 |

## Arm summary — 26 annual observations

| Arm | n years | Mean return | Vol | Sharpe | HAC *t* vs 0 | Hit rate |
|---|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| **Growers (streak ≥ 3yr)** | 26 | **+12.83%/yr** | 12.53% | **+1.02** | **+7.21** | 88% |
| Equal-weight basket | 26 | +13.56%/yr | 13.97% | +0.97 | +7.36 | 88% |
| High-yield non-growers | 15 | +15.46%/yr | 27.73% | +0.56 | +3.38 | 73% |

*Note: all arms have high t-stats vs zero return because the universe is survivorship-biased
large-cap stocks with strong multi-decade records. The within-basket spread is what matters.*

## The honest test — grower spread vs equal-weight baseline

The grower screen is applied *within* the basket; the spread measures the incremental
return from the growth filter, controlling for universe-level survivorship.

| Comparison | n years | Mean spread | HAC *t* | Inference |
|---|--:|--:|--:|---|
| Growers (3yr) vs EW basket | 26 | **−0.73%/yr** | **−1.51** | **Below inference bar** |
| HY non-growers vs EW basket | 15 | +2.40%/yr | +0.92 | Not significant |

- The grower spread is **−0.73%/yr** at HAC *t* = **−1.51** — statistically
  indistinguishable from zero, and if anything in the *wrong direction*.
- In the median year **31 of 40 names** (78%) qualify as growers; the filter barely
  differentiates the basket, so the spread is diluted to noise by construction.
- Tightening to 5+ consecutive years narrows the bucket but does not produce a
  significant positive spread (further reducing breadth increases noise without improving
  the point estimate).

## Grower basket composition

| Year range | Median growers per year | Fraction of basket |
|---|--:|--:|
| 2000–2025 | 31 | ~78% |

When 78% of a survivorship-biased basket qualifies as "dividend growers", the signal has
near-zero discriminatory power inside the universe.

## Synthetic positive control — the engine works when there is something to find

On the deterministic synthetic panel (`data.synthetic_panel`), the same engine recovers a
grower premium **only when one is planted**, and reads ≈ 0 in the null:

| Planted premium (pp/yr) | Detected spread | HAC *t* | Detectable? |
|---:|--:|--:|:---:|
| 0% (null) | ≈ −1.6% | −1.37 | no |
| 2% | ≈ −0.2% | −0.19 | no |
| 5% | ≈ +1.9% | +1.59 | no |
| 8% | ≈ +4.0% | +3.37 | yes |

The engine clears the |*t*| ≥ 2 bar only when a premium ≥ ~6–8%/yr is planted over 20
years — illustrating the fundamental power constraint at annual frequency with small
samples. The real spread of −0.73%/yr is well inside the noise band.

## Verdict

- **Signal — WEAK.** The HAC t-stat on the grower-vs-EW spread is −1.51 (direction wrong,
  magnitude below the inference bar). No robustly significant within-basket alpha from the
  dividend-growth screen.
- **Tradability — MIRAGE.** The whole basket is survivorship-biased; the spread is
  near-zero and negative; annual rebalance costs would consume any edge; and the information
  is publicly known and priced in advance.
- **vs EW — No Edge.** Growers lag the equal-weight basket by 0.73%/yr. High-yield
  non-growers show a noisy +2.40%/yr over EW (t = 0.92) — not significant.
